causal_hypothesis: A completed-day close that is rising within its recent five-day high-low range faster than its own three-day signal line may identify short-horizon range-position acceleration before the next hourly fill.
economic_hypothesis: A full-capital BTC long-or-zero-yield-cash policy using the completed-day default stochastic SlowK minus SlowD sign may improve fee- and slippage-adjusted drawdown and Calmar versus matched buy-and-hold only if it retains frozen upside, annual breadth and symmetric gap-neighbor stability.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: The official implementation defaults to FastK period five, SlowK period three with simple moving-average type zero, and SlowD period three with simple moving-average type zero. FastK is one hundred times close minus the rolling lowest low divided by rolling highest high minus lowest low; a machine-flat range maps to zero. SlowK smooths FastK and SlowD smooths SlowK.
primary_prior_matrix.parameter_boundary: This fixes exact 5-3-3 calculation behavior and a zero primary K-minus-D crossover. It does not prove a BTC trading rule or any economic value.

primary_prior_matrix.identity: Evens, Stochastics, Technical Analysis of Stocks and Commodities 17(9), 1999, publisher record of Lane's indicator
primary_prior_matrix.finding: The publisher record attributes the classic stochastic oscillator to George Lane and distinguishes its closing-price range-position calculation from normalized relative-strength indicators.
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The historical indicator identity supplies no matched-capital Bitcoin evidence and no permission to scan periods, smoothing or gap thresholds.

primary_prior_matrix.identity: Hudson and Urquhart, Technical trading and cryptocurrencies, Annals of Operations Research 297, 2021, DOI 10.1007/s10479-019-03357-1
primary_prior_matrix.finding: The study evaluates oscillator rules within almost fifteen thousand cryptocurrency technical rules and reports no Bitcoin predictability in its out-of-sample period despite broader in-sample and cross-crypto findings.
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: This permits one tightly frozen Bitcoin oscillator screen while treating absent Bitcoin OOS persistence as strong counterevidence. It provides no support for selecting a stochastic winner after observing outcomes.

primary_prior_matrix.identity: Gerritsen et al., The profitability of technical trading rules in the Bitcoin market, Finance Research Letters 34, 2020, DOI 10.1016/j.frl.2019.08.011
primary_prior_matrix.finding: The study reports that specific range-breakout rules can improve Bitcoin risk-adjusted performance while other tested technical rules do not outperform buy-and-hold.
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: A smoothed stochastic K-D state is not a range-breakout execution rule. This result supports strict buy-and-hold comparison and branch closure rather than inferring value from general technical-rule evidence.

independence_assessment.not_rsi_or_mfi: Stochastic uses close location inside a five-day high-low range and two nested simple averages; it does not ratio positive and negative close changes or money flows.
independence_assessment.not_single_day_close_location: The closed DRA close-location family uses one complete day's within-bar close position. This family uses a rolling five-day range and the difference between two separately smoothed range-position lines.
independence_assessment.not_donchian: The strategy does not require price to cross a rolling extreme; SlowK can cross SlowD while price stays inside the same high-low range.
independence_assessment.not_aroon: The closed Aroon family uses only the ages of extrema. Stochastic uses closing-price distance within the extreme range and nested smoothing.
independence_assessment.residual_risk: It remains a short-horizon price-range oscillator and may share economic exposure with already closed trend and range-state families, so mathematical distinction does not establish independent alpha.

frozen_pre_outcome_contract.neighbor_rationale: A symmetric ten-point displacement is frozen before outcome access solely to reject a boundary-fragile primary; neither neighbor may replace it.
